properties.evidence: This is the server's only "is this text already here?" computation whose score means something across items, because it is normalised to the text's own self-score. It was built as a guard that runs after a write, at 7 single add_* constructors, and needs the node already in the index for its baseline. So it has no read-only or batch form. create_nodes check_only does not run it (measured), and search_design exposes only raw BM25 scores that do not separate present items from absent ones.
